title: CURRENT V550/V550J SHARED-SUBSTRATE STATIC LOSS COURT

key_findings.finding: LOGICAL_CONTENT_COLUMNS is exactly SHARED_SUBSTRATE_REQUIRED_COLUMNS, a fixed 67-column projection.
Canonicalization preserves incoming extra columns after the required projection, so such columns may be serialized while remaining outside the logical content hash.
Logical hashing is row-order insensitive because per-row hashes are sorted before the outer hash; duplicate row multiplicity remains represented in the row-hash multiset.

Canonicalization synthesizes missing prepared semantics, including unit weight, missingness booleans, semantic authority/status defaults, target-resolution defaults, and association eligibility defaults, before validation.
Substantive duplicate identity is source_norm + canonical_wave_norm + country_code_norm + respondent_id_norm + var_code_norm; multiple substantive rows sharing that tuple fail validation.
The required logical contract has no response-event ID, multiselect component ID, response rank/position, governed predicate ID, branch/cohort ID, or explicit denominator/risk-set/sample-space ID.
JOINT_ONLY selection/extraction authority is present, but identical authoritative semantic preparation relative to base-selected variables is not demonstrated.

Typed missingness distinctions is_missing/is_dk/is_refusal/is_iap and substantive-validity fields are required logical columns, but their populated completeness and authoritative derivation remain empirical unknowns.
weight_value is required and hashed but defaults to 1.0; weight_status exists, while no dedicated respondent-row weight provenance identity is required.
The manifest stores a Parquet SHA and logical content hash as separate integrity mechanisms; load rechecks the Parquet SHA and logical validation.

D08-level fact identity is only partially covered: exact response topology, governed predicate provenance, branch/cohort provenance, and denominator/risk-set identity are not first-class required logical axes.
Static schema cannot prove that all respondents needed to reconstruct every governed risk set, arbitrary conjunction, repeated topology, or future coordinate are physically present.

semantically_different_substrates_same_l.basis: Differences confined to physical extra columns are excluded from LOGICAL_CONTENT_COLUMNS. _clean also collapses null-like lexical tokens and surrounding whitespace for hashing.
semantically_different_substrates_same_l.empirical_limit: Whether a collision corresponds to lawfully distinct populated empirical facts is source/data dependent.

missing_semantic_columns_defaulted_into_.basis: Canonicalization adds semantic defaults before validation; validation does not preserve per-cell source-versus-default provenance.

repeated_or_multiselect_topology_rejecte.basis: Multiple substantive rows under the five-field scalar key are rejected; event/component/rank identity is not in the required key.
repeated_or_multiselect_topology_rejecte.empirical_limit: Actual upstream loss is not proven without populated/source-topology evidence.

joint_only_weaker_semantic_preparation.basis: Selection role proves extraction membership, not equal source-semantic harmonization.

typed_routing_missingness_physically_rep.basis: is_missing, is_dk, is_refusal, is_iap, substantive/validity and handling/source-structure fields are logical columns; complete applicability/risk-set semantics are not proven.

all_D08_fact_identity_distinctions_hashe.basis: Topology, predicate/branch/cohort identity and explicit risk-set/denominator/sample-space identity are not all first-class required logical columns.

branch_or_cohort_reconstruction.basis: No required branch/predicate/cohort identity exists; reconstruction would depend on independently retained generating coordinates and authority.

future_arbitrary_conjunction_replay.basis: Extraction is bounded to the selected base+joint variable union and extra future coordinates are outside logical hash authority unless promoted into the contract.

respondent_ids_enough_for_cotravel.basis: Respondent incidence supports cotravel, but complete risk sets, topology, predicate provenance, and future-variable coverage are separate requirements.

parquet_byte_integrity_equals_semantic_i.basis: Parquet SHA proves serialized-byte integrity; semantic identity is bounded by the logical projection and canonicalization rules.

typed_unknowns: Populated empirical completeness, overlap, prevalence, and source equivalence remain UNKNOWN_WITHOUT_POPULATED_DATA under inherited D05 law.
Whether upstream encodes every repeated/multiselect/ordered topology injectively into a scalar response row is UNKNOWN_WITHOUT_POPULATED_DATA and source implementation evidence.
Whether all JOINT_ONLY variables receive source-equivalent semantic preparation is SEMANTIC_PARITY_NOT_DEMONSTRATED.
